text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, my Japanese textbook is missing...!?
...W-What should I do...!?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...T-That's it! Vivlos! Vivlos should have the textbook!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Vivlos-chan? Hmmm... Looks like she's not here right now! Want to leave a message?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Sigh... Then I'll head over to Sis—
...Ah. We're in different grades, so I can't...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Then is there anyone else I could borrow from...
...Any... friends...――)
